question: How may a hall be arranged when it is endowed with interior space yet built without a separate hall structure?
premises: The verse lists optional hall arrangements.
Interior space can be endowed without a separate hall.
inference: A hall with interior space may be used even without a separate hall structure.
uncertainties: Exact architectural referent of sāvakāśāntaropetaṃ is context-dependent.
plain_english: A hall endowed with interior space may be used even without a separate hall structure.
